0022600190.text: The Atlanta Hawks, 6-4 and first in the Southeast, host the Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East) in the 11th game of Atlanta's season, with the Hawks riding a three-game winning streak and holding a 2-2 home record. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Asa Newell (toe) and Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently beating the Nets 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
